patches.title: Probe jailbreak bootstrap shells on iOS
patches.purpose: Teach Codex shell detection about RootHide .jbroot and rootless /var/jb shell locations, and allow iOS to use the same shell fallback strategy as macOS.
patches.notes: Recheck when upstream changes shell detection or adds first-class iOS/jailbreak shell discovery.

patches.title: Keep Wayland clipboard backend Linux-only
patches.purpose: Prevent arboard's Wayland data-control backend from being selected while cross-compiling Codex for iOS.
patches.notes: Can be retired if upstream scopes Wayland features to Linux without this patch.

patches.title: Enable process-hardening Unix path on iOS
patches.purpose: Include iOS in the Unix process-hardening target set so the crate compiles and uses the intended Apple/Unix implementation.
patches.notes: Recheck if upstream adds iOS to this cfg or restructures process-hardening.

patches.title: Resolve jailbreak system config paths on iOS
patches.purpose: Resolve /etc/codex/config.toml through RootHide .jbroot or rootless /var/jb because Codex is not libvroot-linked.
patches.notes: Retire only when upstream has an equivalent iOS jailbreak bootstrap-aware config resolver.

patches.title: Use Codex native Apple posix_spawn backend on iOS
patches.purpose: Enable the existing native PTY child implementation and Apple posix_spawn extensions on iOS so pure TrollStore unified exec does not fall back to fork/pre_exec and exit 138.
patches.notes: Critical TrollStore runtime patch. Re-evaluate against every upstream PTY/child-process refactor.

patches.title: Poll waitpid on iOS when Tokio SIGCHLD is unavailable
patches.purpose: Prevent already-exited forkless TrollStore commands from remaining permanently running when Tokio does not receive SIGCHLD; ensures terminal status, exitCode and item.completed can arrive.
patches.notes: Critical lifecycle patch. Remove only after real-device proof that upstream child waiting works reliably on pure TrollStore iOS.

patches.title: Keep iOS UserShell on a posix_spawn-compatible launch path
patches.purpose: Avoid the pure TrollStore SIGBUS seen in thread/shellCommand by removing the iOS RedirectForShellTool pre_exec(setsid) callback and using a dedicated process group instead, preserving cancellation cleanup while keeping Apple's posix_spawn path eligible.
patches.notes: Derived from pure TrollStore diagnostics where UserShell completed failed with execution error Sandbox(Signal(10)); iOS SDK defines signal 10 as SIGBUS. UserShell requests SandboxType::None, so this is a process-launch failure rather than a filesystem sandbox denial.

patches.title: Use a process group for iOS unified exec
patches.purpose: Avoid POSIX_SPAWN_SETSID EPERM only on CodexApp forkless RootHide/DEB while retaining native posix_spawn and process-group cancellation for unified exec.
patches.notes: Requires CODEXAPP_SPAWN_EXTERNAL=1, CA_RUNTIME_ROOT_MODE=roothide and CA_RUNTIME_INSTALL_CHANNEL=deb; other iOS installs and non-iOS targets continue using NewSession.

patches.title: Keep iOS config probing inside jailbreak paths
patches.purpose: Avoid RootHide/DEB EPERM from the real /etc/codex path by resolving system and managed config through .jbroot or /var/jb on iOS.
patches.notes: iOS-only. Non-iOS system and managed config paths remain unchanged.

patches.title: Fallback denied iOS RootHide PTY launches to pipes
patches.purpose: Keep tty-requested unified exec usable when iOS 18 RootHide/DEB rejects openpty with EPERM, without globally disabling PTY support.
patches.notes: Fallback is limited to CodexApp forkless RootHide/DEB and PTY permission-denied errors; other PTY failures remain errors. Pipe fallback keeps stdin writable and preserves inherited descriptors.

related_non_cli_patches.scope: Bundled Bash runtime, not OpenAI Codex source
related_non_cli_patches.notes: Managed separately from the numbered Codex CLI patchset.
